# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the problem, the change, and any user-visible behavior changes.

Related issue (if any):

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain any checks you could not run.
For UI changes, include screenshots with fictional or public data.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/aalmada/agent-package-manager-extension/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and kept the change focused.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior, or explained why none are needed.
- [ ] I updated relevant user documentation, or explained why none is needed.
- [ ] I checked that logs, fixtures, and screenshots contain no credentials or private data.
- [ ] If changing APM dependencies, I committed the manifest, lockfile, and APM-deployed files together without hand-editing generated files.
